description: Score the candidate's résumé against one job: match percentage, per-dimension scores, the reason and the skills they are missing. Give exactly one of job_id, application_id or job_description. Job pages are not fetched here: for a posting outside the catalog, read it yourself and pass its text as job_description. Uses their monthly AI allowance, and a score for a catalog job is saved on their board. Rewriting the résumé is not done here: tailor_url opens that on TrueInterview.
name: match_resume_to_job
title: Score my résumé against a job
